caption: The blue cushion on the black-legged chair on the left side of the scene has been replaced with a green cushion. A white toy goose plush has appeared on the white table in the center of the scene. The number of green stools on the right side of the scene has increased to two.

The three people in the center of the scene, who were previously facing forward with their hands clasped across their chests and their legs bent into a squatting position, have now turned to the left side of the frame. Their bodies are leaning to the right, with their arms extended to the right side of their bodies.

The posture of the person in white clothes changes from facing the left side with the left hand supporting and the right hand raised to the side, waist tilted to the right, right leg bent and standing, left leg extended backward, to lying on the ground with the body facing downward, head naturally relaxed, hands holding both sides of the legs, legs spread apart, and feet pointing upward.

The mouse has moved from the front left of the scene to the small hole in the wooden box on the right side, with only its head peeking out. The number of food scattered on the wooden board has decreased.

The green seasoning bottle on the right side of the table has disappeared. The transparent plastic bottle with a green cap on the right side of the table has rotated from facing forward to facing left.

The posture of the figure changes from standing with the right leg bent and supporting the body, while the left leg is raised and bent, with both arms extended to the sides, to a position where the body is slightly tilted to the right, the left leg is lifted high, the right leg stands firmly on the ground, and both arms are extended forward.

The bouquet of blue and purple flowers on the bedside table to the left of the first bed on the right side of the scene has disappeared. The color of the bedside table next to the leftmost bed in the second row has changed from white to red.
The rusty red bicycle that was originally parked in the middle of the road has moved to the right side of the road, near the gray pillar and bucket.
A new round cake has appeared on the picnic mat in front of the white cup and red cup.

The white keyboard on the center of the second row of desks from the left has been replaced with a black keyboard. The gray trash can in the bottom right corner of the first row of desks is no longer visible. The black office chair in front of the computer desk on the far right of the second row has turned from facing the left side to facing the back of the room.

The wooden table and chair on the left side of the scene have moved to the right, now positioned next to a bench. The green hose on the ground in the middle of the greenhouse has been moved to the right side of the scene. The brown flower pot at the far end of the right side of the greenhouse has decreased in size.
The area is now brighter. The middle chair in the first row on the right side of the classroom has been moved to the left, closer to the blackboard.

The black keyboard on the desktop has been replaced with a black keyboard stand holding four additional lenses. The red and blue flags in the middle of the wall above the monitor have disappeared. The camera lens on the right side of the desk has moved to the left, and a new camera lens has appeared in its original position. The yellow and green pens in the pen holder on the left side of the desk have swapped positions with the black pen. The blue sticky notes on the left side of the monitor are no longer visible.

The scene has darkened, and the ambient lighting has become darker. The white pickup truck in the distance on the left side of the frame is no longer visible. The red car that was previously at the back right of the screen is now gone. The black SUV that was previously at the back right of the screen is now parked in a different location. The white car that was previously at the back left of the screen is now gone. The blue light under the house on the right side of the screen has changed from purple to blue.

The lighting has brightened. The white bottle on the right side of the second shelf disappeared. The pink basin on the third shelf moved to the position of the white basin on the fourth shelf. The white basin on the fourth shelf disappeared. The box of disinfectant on the third shelf disappeared.

The streetlight at the corner near the left side of the scene, next to the pedestrian crossing, has decreased in size. A man wearing a black vest and white shorts appears on the left side of the road, standing beside the road with his hands on his waist, facing the camera.
The area is now darker. The gray rectangular pillow on the lower bed has appeared.The white box on the first layer of the blue and orange rack on the left side of the bed has appeared.
The word "Caution" on the wall above the yellow bicycle has been replaced with "Cautious".

A person wearing a white top and blue pants has appeared in front of the black stove on the right side of the kitchen, facing it with her back to the camera. A bright blue sign with the word "kitchen" has appeared on the wooden floor at the front of the scene, positioned in front of the round table. The transparent glass water bottle has appeared to the left of the yellow table. The white chair behind the yellow table has appeared. The blue and white striped plate in the upper right corner of the black countertop has appeared. The transparent glass goblet on the black countertop to the left of the stove has appeared. The stainless steel oven handle on the right side of the stove has changed from black to silver.
